benefits.name: Round-Trip Companion Coupon
benefits.description: A round-trip companion coupon for Amtrak travel, issued upon account opening and on each card anniversary.
benefits.terms: Issued upon account opening and again on each card anniversary.

benefits.name: One-Class Upgrade Certificate
benefits.description: A certificate to upgrade to the next-highest cabin class on an Amtrak trip, issued upon account opening and on each card anniversary.
benefits.terms: One certificate per year, issued upon account opening and again on each card anniversary. Upgrades to the next-highest cabin class only.

benefits.name: Station Lounge Pass
benefits.description: A pass granting entry to any Amtrak metropolitan lounge location, issued upon account opening and on each card anniversary.
benefits.terms: One pass per year, issued upon account opening and again on each card anniversary.

benefits.name: Onboard Food & Beverage Rebate
benefits.description: 20% rebate, as a statement credit, on Amtrak onboard food and beverage purchases.
benefits.terms: 20% rebate on onboard food and beverage purchases, credited as a statement credit. No fixed dollar cap identified in sourcing; modeled as an ongoing per-purchase rebate rather than a capped periodic credit.

benefits.name: Amtrak Travel Redemption Rebate
benefits.description: Rebate of points back when redeeming Amtrak Guest Rewards points for Amtrak travel.
benefits.terms: 5% of redeemed points rebated back to the account when points are redeemed for Amtrak travel.

benefits.name: Accelerated Tier Qualifying Points
benefits.description: Earn 1,000 Tier Qualifying Points (TQPs) toward Amtrak Guest Rewards elite status for every $5,000 in qualifying card purchases.
benefits.terms: 1,000 TQPs per $5,000 spent on the card, helping cardholders reach Amtrak Guest Rewards Select/Select Plus/Select Executive status faster.

benefits.name: Points Don't Expire
benefits.description: Amtrak Guest Rewards points earned on the card don't expire as long as the card account remains open and in good standing.

earningRates.terms: Amtrak travel purchases, including onboard purchases.
Dining, other travel purchases, transit, and rideshare.
